description: In every PA-model, if a fixed arithmetic formula \(A(i,u,\bar x)\) has a witness \(u\) for every \(i\lt n\), then one beta code records a suitable witness at each such index. The assertion includes arbitrary internal lengths and fixed parameters.
signature:

  (h :
    ∀ (i : M),

          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i) n →
        ∃ y,
          φ.Realize
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x i) y)) :
  ∃ c d,
    ∀ (i : M),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i) n →

                (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x i) y)
